Chapter 2
Normal Ending
It was a peaceful afternoon. The sun was slowly setting over the hills.
Oh, it's [b]you[/b]. I didn't expect to see you here.
Wait, really? For me?
I... I suppose you can be somewhat thoughtful sometimes.
Wow, you actually managed to calm her down. Impressive!
We walked together along the path to the old cottage. The atmosphere was certainly something.
As evening approached, the sky began to shift rapidly.
The weather suddenly turned terrible, matching her mood.
This is all your fault! If you hadn't made me mad, we would be home before the rain!
She ran off into the storm, leaving you completely alone on the path.
Hey there! We were just heading to the arcade. Want to come?
Inside, the fire painted the room in a warm, gentle glow.
You know... today wasn't [i]completely[/i] awful.
D-don't get the wrong idea! I just meant the weather was nice! And the snack was... acceptable!
She quickly turned her head away and walked ahead to hide her blushing face.
The lamps were lit and we sat in comfortable silence.
Well, it's late. See you tomorrow at school.
She waved briefly and went upstairs. A completely ordinary end to the day.
